spans.s: सिच् vt. 6U (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after a preposition ending in इ or उ) (pp. सिक्त; pres. सिंचति-ते; desid. सिसिक्षति-ते) 1. To sprinkle, to scatter in small drops; 2. to moisten, to soak, to water (as plants), Megh.i.26; 3. to pour out, to discharge, to emit, to shed; 4. to pour in, to instil, जाह्यं धियो हरति सिंचति वाचि सत्यम् Bhartr.ii.23.With अभि-, 1. to besprinkle, to wet; 2. to pour upon, धारापातैस्त्वमिव कमलान्यभ्यषिंचन् (v.l.) मुखानि Megh.i.48; 3. to inaugurate by sprinkling with sacred water, to initiate, अग्निवर्णमभिषिच्य राघवः R.xix.1.With उद्-, 1. to sprinkle, to pour; 2. to make proud, न तस्योत्सिषिचे मनः R.xvii.43.With नि-, 1. to sprinkle, to pour, R.iii.26; 2. to impregnate, निर्षिंचन्माधवीमेतां लतां कौंदीं च नर्तयन् Vikr.ii. (where the word is used in both the senses).With परि-, to sprinkle, to pour round.
सिच् Pass. (सिच्यते) to be sprinkled.With उद्-, 1. to be thrown upwards; 2. to be proud, to be elated.

सिच् Caus. (सेचयति-ते) to cause to sprinkle.With अभि-, to cause to be inaugurated.With आ-, to cause to be sprinkled, ततमासेचयेत्तैलं वक्त्रे श्रोत्रे च पार्थिवः M.viii.272.With उद्-, to cause to be proud, M.viii.71.
